premises.text: Industry spends heavily on new drugs yet still fails to catch livestock outbreaks early enough to prevent large losses
premises.evidence_span: the industry spends over $20 billion a year developing new drugs and treatments to try to manage these diseases, and it's estimated that $13 billion in losses can be prevented if we were able to catch them early on

premises.text: REX standardizes multi-source clinical and genomics data into analytics tools for veterinarians and drug developers
premises.evidence_span: we built a software platform of data visualization and analytics tools for the industry

premises.text: Vets can find efficient diagnostics and treatments; when drugs fail, the platform predicts causal genes and pathways to speed new vaccines/drugs
premises.evidence_span: by mining our records, livestock veterinarians can then find the most efficient and most effective treatments to cure the disease

premises.text: Commercial model is subscription access for large livestock and pharma customers with network effects across their relationships
premises.evidence_span: We take advantage of a natural network effect from their customer-vendor relationships, and we charge them an annual subscription fee
